summary: Implemented and exported `Perc`, added percentile API documentation and a v0.12.1 release note, and added focused tests. The focused tests pass (8 passed); the full suite had 1,787 passed, 81 skipped, and 6 xfailed, with one unrelated existing failure in `tests/test_axisgrid.py::TestFacetGrid::test_subplot_kws` due to the installed Matplotlib class name.
